title: A symbolic user function that returns a constant, e.g. True of a preStepUserFunction, fails with a cast error
author: Claude-JG
description: Found by revision2026c step RG12.2: CreateSymbolicUserFunction records the returned value; a Python bool, int or float is no symbolic expression, and the conversion fails with 'Unable to cast Python instance of type bool to C++ type ?'. A constant result becomes a symbolic constant.
releaseNotes: A symbolic user function that returns a constant, e.g. True of a preStepUserFunction, is recorded as a symbolic constant instead of failing with a cast error (revision2026c step RG12.2.1)
